question.problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB}$, $\overset{\to }{AC}$ and $\overset{\to }{AD}$, given the points $A(3,-2,2)$, $B(4,3,2)$, $C(1,3,5)$, $D(2,4,-6).$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the displacement vectors $\overset{\to }{AB},$ $\overset{\to }{AC},$ and $\overset{\to }{AD}$ that span the parallelepiped:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =b-a \\  & =(4i+3j+2k)-(3i-2j+2k) \\  & =i+5j \\  & =⟨1,5,0⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AC} & =c-a \\  & =(i+3j+5k)-(3i-2j+2k) \\  & =-2i+5j+3k \\  & =⟨-2,5,3⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AD} & =d-a \\  & =(2i+4j-6k)-(3i-2j+2k) \\  & =-i+6j-8k \\  & =⟨-1,6,-8⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to find the volume of the parallelepiped, we need to take the absolute value of the triple product of the above vectors.

Computing the triple product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB}\cdot (\overset{\to }{AC}\times \overset{\to }{AD}) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & 0 \\ -2 & 5 & 3 \\ -1 & 6 & -8\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ 6 & -8\end{aligned}|-5\cdot |\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 \\ -1 & -8\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ -1 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =(5\cdot (-8)-6\cdot 3)-5((-2)\cdot (-8)-(-1)\cdot 3)+0 \\  & =-58-95 \\  & =-153.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the volume of the corresponding parallelpiped spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB},$ $\overset{\to }{AC},$ and $\overset{\to }{AD}$ is

$$
V=|-153|=153.
$$
